seo_desc: Andover holds its tree lighting on December 4 at the Andover Community Center.
lede: Andover holds its tree lighting on December 4 at the Andover Community Center.
celebrates: Andover's holiday season starts with the city's Tree Lighting Event at the Andover Community Center on Hanson Boulevard. The city posted the Friday, December 4 date on its news page and Facebook page, and community calendars list Santa and Mrs. Claus and a food and toy drive. The Community Center also hosts a Carousel Craft Show on December 5 and high school hockey games through the winter, according to the city's news page.
lastyear: The city's calendar archive lists a Tree Lighting Event on December 6, 2025, so the evening is an annual one. We did not find a 2025 recap from the city, so this page sticks to the 2026 notice. The city's Facebook save the date calls it the Andover Tree Lighting Event at the Community Center, the same venue as this year.
facts: Andover City Hall is at 1685 Crosstown Boulevard NW, but the tree lighting is held at the Community Center on Hanson Boulevard, a different address. The city's news page also lists the Andover Family Fun Fest as its big summer celebration, which the city describes as craft shows, kids activities, food and music around the City Hall campus.
trains: Andover has no train ride of its own that we could verify. Northstar commuter rail stations in Anoka and Coon Rapids are the nearest rail stops. The CPKC Holiday Train stops in Hastings on December 12 at 8:45 pm, in Cottage Grove on December 13 at 5:15 pm and at Saint Paul Union Depot on December 13 at 7 pm, with free concerts, according to Explore Minnesota. The Minnesota Transportation Museum runs Santa's Train Shop and Caboose Rides at the Jackson Street Roundhouse, 193 Pennsylvania Ave E in Saint Paul, with pictures with Santa on the North Pole Mail Train, caboose rides, crafts and story time from 10 am to 4 pm, according to the museum.

Community calendars list Santa and Mrs. Claus at the tree lighting.
